title: Graphing a Downward-Shifted Reciprocal Hyperbola
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Analyze and describe the graph of y = 1/x - 2 by identifying its parent function, shift, asymptotes, domain, range, and intercepts.

steps.title: Identify the Parent Function and Vertical Shift
steps.explanation: Subtracting 2 from the parent reciprocal function y = 1/x shifts its graph 2 units downward.
steps.why: Vertical translation downward by 2 subtracts 2 from every output value.

steps.title: Determine the Asymptotes, Domain, and Range
steps.explanation: The vertical asymptote remains the y-axis x = 0, while the horizontal asymptote shifts down 2 units from y = 0 to y = -2.

steps.title: Find the x-Intercept and Guide Points
steps.explanation: There is no y-intercept since x != 0. The right branch crosses the x-axis at (1/2, 0) and passes through (1, -1), while the left branch passes through (-1, -3).
steps.why: Solving 1/x = 2 locates the unique x-intercept at x = 1/2.
